svg.title: Bank teller — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as bank teller, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A banknote and round coin sit above a service-counter line beside two short cash-stack edges. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: short hair, a rounded face.
